text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To prepare for the Japanese Derby, it's essential for Winning Ticket to condition herself to long-distance races—so we aim for the Hopeful Stakes first.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite how much we train for the race, though, her time isn't improving.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taking pity on the struggling Winning Ticket, Biwa Hayahide proposes that they hold a three-way scrimmage with Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After racing against them, Winning Ticket escapes her slump and even improves her own record.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I realize that having rivals is of great importance to her.
